purpose: Close TOCTOU between health evidence and action without putting full probes on the interactive fast path.

freshness_classes.FAST_READ_CACHE: event-driven cached evidence; safe for non-mutating fast reads within unchanged generation vector
freshness_classes.INTERACTIVE_CONTROL: short-lived/event-invalidated evidence for interactive capability; targeted refresh only when stale
freshness_classes.MUTATION_ADMISSION: cached evidence is advisory; authoritative revision/fence/idempotency/storage preconditions are checked at effect boundary

LOCAL_BUILD.commit_guard: build result binds exact source/input hashes

PUBLICATION.commit_guard: re-read destination identity/revision and artifact hash at atomic publication; lost receipt => COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

negative_controls: green health snapshot followed by generation change before action must be rejected/refreshed
process restart must not reuse prior in-memory lease
wall-clock rollback/advance must not extend authoritative lease
remote dependency failure must not force full local re-probe storm
stale lease must not be silently promoted by a fresh unrelated dimension
